findings.evidence: `CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean:208-215` `theorem CofinalValueFor.lt_one … : v.restrict a < 1`; `CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean:236-239` `@[simp] theorem cofinalValueFor_top_iff : CofinalValueFor v ⊤ a ↔ CofinalValue v a`, already used this way at `CofinalIdeal/Greatest.lean:545-547` (`cofinalValueFor_top_iff.mpr (hall a haI)` then `hcof.lt_one`).
findings.fix: Delete `CofinalValue.lt_one` and its `Main results` entry (line 52); in `Continuous/TopologicallyNilpotent.lean:41` cite `CofinalValueFor.lt_one` instead. A consumer downstream of `CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean` gets the statement as `(cofinalValueFor_top_iff.mpr h).lt_one`. Only if a genuine upstream consumer appears should the ⊤-case be stated separately.
findings.issue: `CofinalValue.lt_one` restates `CofinalValueFor.lt_one` (`TauCeti/RingTheory/Valuation/CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean:208`, same conclusion `v.restrict a < 1`) at `H = ⊤`, with a second independent proof. The stated justification is import order, but the new lemma has no consumer upstream of `CofinalIdeal/Basic.lean` — or anywhere: `grep -rn "CofinalValue.lt_one" TauCeti` returns only docstring mentions (`CharacteristicGroup.lean:52,96`, `Continuous/TopologicallyNilpotent.lean:41`), and the new file never applies it.

summary: The topological-nilpotence material is new and reuses Mathlib properly, but the added `CofinalValue.lt_one` is a `H = ⊤` special case of the existing `CofinalValueFor.lt_one`, reachable in one line through the existing `@[simp]` bridge `cofinalValueFor_top_iff`, and it has no consumer anywhere in the repo.
